title: Range slider: Warning color (daisyUI)
notes:
Range slider is used to select a value by sliding a handle.

Needs daisyUI installed (npm i -D daisyui, then @plugin "daisyui" in your CSS).

Original file: https://github.com/saadeghi/daisyui/blob/master/packages/docs/src/routes/(routes)/components/range/+page.md
code: <input type="range" min="0" max="100" value="40" class="range range-warning" />
